newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares hurt by firm rates, shed 2.25pct.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares hurt by firm rates, shed 2.25pct.

text.p: Greek equities which started Thursday's session in an upbeat mood were down 2.25 percent in mid-session in moderate volume as traders watched interbank rates jump on forex outflows.
"The market is coming down but volume is not heavy and this is good. The jump in interbank rates could be the reason making traders nervous," a floor trader said.
Decliners led advancers 157 to 53 with the benchmark share index below 1,700 points.

The one-month Athibor, the interbank market's reference rate jumped to 11.50 from Wednesday's 10.93 percent on continued forex outflows, dealers said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
